crossRefs.note: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.
I am Yahweh, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.
Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Edom, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because he pursued…

Yahweh will cause you to be struck before your enemies. You will go out one way against them, and will flee seven ways…
You will pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of Yahweh.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Israel has cast off that which is good. The enemy will pursue him.
translations.bsb: But Israel has rejected good; an enemy will pursue him.
translations.kjv: Israel hath cast off the thing that is good: the enemy shall pursue
translations.asv: Israel hath cast off that which is good: the enemy shall pursue him.
